summary: Within the last 10 minutes of the authorized window (2026-10-06T10:52:49Z to 2026-10-06T11:02:49Z), checkout shows no observed failures: the increase in checkout spans carrying STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 0 for every checkout operation, and 0 across all services except ad/flagd/recommendation flagd EventStream spans (1.11). Checkout's client-side dependency calls (payment Charge, cart GetCart/EmptyCart, currency Convert, product-catalog GetProduct, shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder) all carried rpc_grpc_status_code 0 in that window, and three sampled traces inside the window were all successful (gRPC status 0, HTTP 200), e.g. trace ids 28d28b9651f1bb2d03409b888785ef11, dcdf792d4413d38e53395144abb8ac83 and fe49120b172fe62115de967eba336a76. Latency evidence does not establish elevation: checkout PlaceOrder server-span p95 estimate was 182.5 ms in the last 10 min against 122.5 ms, 175.7 ms and 37.5 ms in the three preceding 10-minute windows, i.e. inside the recent range, on only ~10 spans and coarse 25/50/75/100/250 ms buckets (no span above 250 ms). Counter-evidence: checkout errors did occur earlier in the same hour (cumulative error-span increase 53.27 over 10:02:49-11:02:49 while 0 in the last 10 min), concentrated on a failing payment Charge call; trace d89e9913ebe71b3b1b3aa97abc5f931e at 2026-10-06T10:46:17Z shows checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge failing with grpc status 2, 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', propagating to PlaceOrder grpc 13 and frontend POST /api/checkout HTTP 500. Errors were 0 in every 5-minute slice from 10:47:49 onward. So the reported elevated errors are not corroborated in the last 10 minutes (a real failure episode ended roughly 5-15 minutes before the window), and several items remain unobserved (no error-status series for email/shipping/currency/product-catalog/quote, no complete trace graph).

claims.text: In the last 10 minutes (10:52:49-11:02:49Z) the increase over 600s in checkout spans with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 0 for every checkout operation: CartService/GetCart, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and PaymentService/Charge each 0, while the same operations carried STATUS_CODE_UNSET counts of 10 (PlaceOrder, Charge, GetCart, EmptyCart, GetQuote, ShipOrder, HTTP POST, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart), 18.89 (ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) and 28.89 (CurrencyService/Convert). STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status, not that the call succeeded.

Across all services in the last 10 minutes, the only non-zero error-status span increases were ad 1.11, flagd 1.11 and recommendation 1.11 (all flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream-type spans); checkout, cart, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator and payment all reported 0.

Checkout's client-side RPC counts by gRPC status in the last 10 minutes were all on status code 0: PaymentService/Charge 10.0, CartService/EmptyCart 10.0, CartService/GetCart 10.0, ShippingService/GetQuote 10.0, ShippingService/ShipOrder 10.0, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 18.89, CurrencyService/Convert 28.89; the only non-zero-status series present was PaymentService/Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code 2 (value 0).

Three sampled traces inside the last 10 minutes show successful checkout flows: trace 28d28b9651f1bb2d03409b888785ef11 and trace dcdf792d4413d38e53395144abb8ac83 (spans starting 11:02:12-11:02:13Z; checkout CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 59.8 ms and 47.0 ms, rpc.grpc.status_code 0; email POST /send_order_confirmation HTTP 200) and trace fe49120b172fe62115de967eba336a76 (10:56:48Z; PlaceOrder 97.6 ms, rpc.grpc.status_code 0). These are biased samples, not complete trace graphs.

Checkout PlaceOrder server-span p95 estimates per 10-minute window were 182.5 ms (10:52:49-11:02:49), 122.5 ms (10:42:49-10:52:49), 175.7 ms (10:32:49-10:42:49) and 37.5 ms (10:22:49-10:32:49), so the last-window value lies inside the range of the preceding three windows.

The checkout PlaceOrder bucket distribution in the last 10 minutes covers only ~10 spans: 4.44 spans <= 50 ms, 0 in (50,75] ms, ~4.44 in (75,100] ms, ~1.11 in (100,250] ms and 0 above 250 ms (le=250 equals the +Inf total of 10.0), so the 182.5 ms p95 estimate comes from interpolation inside a wide 100-250 ms bucket on a small sample.

Checkout's client-side calls to payment oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge in the last 10 minutes were fast: the duration histogram shows 10.0 calls, 2.22 at <= 5 ms, 4.44 at <= 10 ms and all 10.0 at <= 25 ms, with none above 25 ms; sampled Charge spans were 3.0-6.2 ms (checkout client) and 1.2-3.2 ms (payment server).

No HTTP server request series with a 5xx status code was returned for the last 10 minutes; the only http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series present for the whole app were cart (http_response_status_code 200, 108.9) and flagd (200, 35.56).

The payment service processed app_payment_transactions_total in the last 10 minutes: CAD 2.22 and USD 7.78 (single payment pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv, service_version 2.0.2); the metric carries no failure/decline status label in this view.

Checkout error-span activity was cumulative 53.27 (STATUS_CODE_ERROR) over 10:02:49-11:02:49 with 557.41 (UNSET), i.e. real checkout error spans occurred within that hour but not in its last 10 minutes, where the same error series read 0.

Slice by slice, checkout error spans appeared in 10:12:49-10:22:49 (CartService/GetCart 4.18, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 4.18), 10:22:49-10:32:49 (GetCart 11.11, PlaceOrder 11.11), 10:32:49-10:42:49 (PlaceOrder 3.57, PaymentService/Charge 3.57, payment grpc Charge 3.57) and 10:42:49-10:52:49 (PlaceOrder 5.56, PaymentService/Charge 5.56, payment grpc Charge 5.56), with frontend /api/checkout errors only in the latter two windows.

At 5-minute resolution the last checkout/payment error burst is confined to 10:42:49-10:47:49 (checkout PlaceOrder 6.25, checkout PaymentService/Charge 6.25, payment grpc Charge 6.25); 10:47:49-10:52:49, 10:52:49-10:57:49 and 10:57:49-11:02:49 all read 0 for checkout and payment error series.

Trace d89e9913ebe71b3b1b3aa97abc5f931e (spans starting 2026-10-06T10:46:17Z, just before the last-10-minute window) shows the failure chain: checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; payment server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge error=true; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error=true with rpc.grpc.status_code=13; frontend POST /api/checkout and frontend/proxy ingress HTTP 500 (with load-generator POST HTTP 500).

The reported 'elevated errors' most plausibly corresponds to the failure episode that ran until about 10:47Z (payment Charge returning 'Invalid token', checkout PlaceOrder grpc 13, frontend /api/checkout HTTP 500), not to the last 10 minutes, which the telemetry shows as quiet; confirmation would require an error-rate or trace query over a wider period than the sampled views here.

The checkout PlaceOrder p95 estimate rising from ~122.5 ms to ~182.5 ms between the two most recent 10-minute windows is not a demonstrated latency regression: the value is inside the 37.5-175.7 ms range of the preceding windows, rests on ~10 spans, and is produced by interpolation within a 100-250 ms histogram bucket, so a comparable-baseline trend cannot be established from these views.

Counter-evidence to reading the last 10 minutes as healthy: checkout error spans existed in every earlier slice of the same hour and a real payment-Charge failure was captured at 10:46:17Z (trace d89e9913ebe71b3b1b3aa97abc5f931e), only about 6.5 minutes before the last-10-minute window began; the window's zero error counts therefore describe an interval that follows a failure episode rather than evidence of general health.

Counter-evidence that the whole system was error-free in the last 10 minutes: non-zero error-status span increases were returned for ad (1.11), flagd (1.11) and recommendation (1.11) on flagd EventStream spans; these are not checkout-related and their visible status evidence does not attribute them to checkout.

Rejected: that checkout's dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency in the last 10 minutes. In that window every checkout client call carried rpc_grpc_status_code 0 (error series, including rpc_grpc_status_code 2 on Charge, read 0), checkout-to-payment Charge durations stayed <= 25 ms, and the sampled traces of those calls (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, email, payment) show rpc.grpc.status_code 0 / HTTP 200.

gaps: The error-status span query for the slice 10:02:49-10:12:49 returned status no_data (result_count 0, source_start_at null), so error activity in that slice is unknown rather than zero.

The requested 10-minute trace search for checkout with limit 20 was refused as RESULT_TOO_LARGE (view_tokens 115930/25000, status error), so no complete trace graph exists for the last 10 minutes; only 3 traces were sampled (two at 11:02:12-11:02:13Z, one at 10:56:48Z), and 'backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist' was reported for those samples.

No error-status span series were returned for email, shipping, currency, product-catalog or quote in the last 10 minutes, so their error status is unobserved (unknown, not zero); the evidence covers them only indirectly via checkout's client-side spans and client-side histograms.

Checkout histogram-based latency is coarse and low-count (buckets at 5/10/25/50/75/100/250 ms, ~10 PlaceOrder spans, ~10 Charge spans), so percentile precision and any latency trend beyond the four 10-minute windows compared here are unresolved.

Whether the checkout/payment error pattern resumed after the authorized window end (11:02:49Z), and its underlying cause, cannot be determined from the authorized window; the payment 'Invalid token' condition is only observed as an error message on one sampled trace.
next_steps: Human follow-up: inspect the payment Charge 'Invalid token' failure path (and any loyalty-level/flag condition referenced in the message) for the episode ending around 10:47Z, and check whether it recurred after 11:02:49Z before treating the service as recovered.

Re-run an error-rate/latency review over a wider period with a complete, comparable baseline (e.g., longer windows and finer histograms) to size the earlier error episode and to confirm or reject any checkout latency drift.

Verify error telemetry coverage for email, shipping, currency, product-catalog and quote, since their error series were absent in the queried window and absence of a series is not evidence of zero errors.
